title: Davis Square Housing Snapshot
snippet: Rents near Davis Square are somewhat lower than Harvard Square but still above the Massachusetts state average.
full_text: The Somerville Housing Office reports that average rents near Davis Square run somewhat lower than comparable listings near Harvard Square, though still above the Massachusetts state average, with one-bedroom units commonly shared by two or more tenants to reduce individual cost.
